notes.title: Update 0.7.0
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]It's been quite a while since the last update — I'm very aware of that. Unfortunately, I haven't been able to dedicate as much time to the game as I would’ve liked. I'm working on it solo, so every major change takes a lot of time and energy. Still — the update is finally here, and it's a big one![/p][p]The most important new feature is [b]multiplayer mode[/b]! After several rounds of testing, it seems to be running fairly stable, but there might still be some issues — if you spot anything, please let me know. This is just the beginning, and I’ll definitely continue improving the system.[/p][p]In addition to that:[/p][list][*][p]The game has been upgraded to the latest versions of used modules and frameworks.[/p][/*][*][p]A lot has changed under the hood, and some things you’ll notice directly.[/p][/*][*][p]New bugs may have appeared — I’ll be fixing them as quickly as I can, so any reports are very welcome.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you so much to everyone who kept supporting the project and patiently waited during the silence. It really means a lot to me.[/p][p]See you in future updates![/p][hr][/hr][h3] Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed scene transitions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pricing bug at the new car dealer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed part naming issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inventory and disappearing tools[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Improved car handling[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tire physics[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing stats for the “Always a Full Tank” achievement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing stats for the “Scrap Collector” achievement[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3] Content:[/h3][list][*][p]Added preview image when selecting a profile[/p][/*][*][p]Added video options – render scale[/p][/*][*][p]Added car color selection at the new car dealer[/p][/*][*][p]Added use of fluids – engine oil and brake fluid[/p][/*][*][p]Added engine wear and seizure system[/p][/*][*][p]Added character model selection when creating a new profile[/p][/*][*][p]Added color selection for coolant system hose connectors[/p][/*][*][p]Added multiplayer mode (still in development)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3] Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Player name is now displayed as the profile name instead of Steam username[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution selection changed to a dropdown list[/p][/*][*][p]New minimap icons[/p][/*][*][p]Tire patch settings can now be edited:
CAR TUNE PROJECT_Data\\StreamingAssets\\Setup\\[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Huge thanks to everyone who continued supporting the project and patiently waited through the silence. It really means a lot. See you in the next updates![/h3]

notes.title: Update 0.6.6
notes.content:
Dear Players,

I would like to sincerely thank you for your support and understanding, especially considering the time constraints I face. Please be reminded that I work on the game after my regular working hours, so updates may take a bit longer.

Currently, my main focus is on developing the multiplayer mode, and the next major update will feature multiplayer - that's my goal.

I kindly ask you to report any bugs with the most detailed description possible, preferably by sending the GameLog.txt via email or Discord. It truly makes the bug-fixing process much smoother, especially for issues that are challenging to reproduce based solely on descriptions.

[b]Patches:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed "tedi" wheel rim
[*] Graphic improvements
[*] Fixed sticker application in the paint shop (penetration to the other side of the car)
[*] Fixed minor bugs
[/list]

[list]

[*] Added new car "Blitz Caliber"
[*] Added new map "Bieszczady"
[*] Added global drag race leaderboard
[*] Added the option to choose the interior color when buying a new car from the dealer
[*] Many interior parts have additional color variants
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Graphic enhancements
[*] Changes in engine and tire code
[*] Fixed engine installation slots for each car
[*] Improved engine sounds
[/list]

I wish you all a fantastic New Year's Eve, and may the New Year be filled with exciting adventures in our game world!

Best regards,
Bartosz "Wichur" Bieszka

notes.title: Update 0.6.5.7
notes.content:
Since the last update, a lot of time has passed. I have spent a great deal of time optimizing and making changes to the graphics system to ensure smoother gameplay. As a result, the change required a significant overhaul of game files. However, I also had to allocate time for work, personal matters, and household responsibilities. Unfortunately, the game is still being developed outside of regular working hours, and I am doing it alone.
The multiplayer feature was planned for Q1, but I have to postpone it as it still requires a lot of work and improvements.
Currently, the game features 14 unique vehicles (+2 body variants) and over 1500 parts.
Thank you for continuing to play.

[b]Information:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Unity version has been changed, which affected the model files. As a result, the profile file has incorrectly assigned body damage models. They need to be fixed using a hammer or F7 (debug option).
[*] The launch control system automatically activates when the speed reaches zero.
[*] Many minor bugs reported have been fixed.
[*] Recommended rebuild thumbails (Options->Graphics->Rebuild catalog thumbnails)
[/list]

[b]Patches:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue of suspension parts missing for the Turkish region.
[*] Improved suspension calculations.
[*] Optimization improvements.
[*] Fixed memory leaks.
[*] Fixed sockets for the central muffler to guide the pipes.
[*] Fixed an error for adjustable upper control arms (sport version).
[*] Improvements to the new pipe system.
[*] Improvements to races, points calculation.
[/list]

[b]Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added launch control procedure.
[*] Added new, shorter upper control arms for the multi-link system.
[*] Added straightening of part sockets using a frame straightener.
[*] Added new stickers.
[*] Added a new track, "Toruno."
[*] Added a new track, "Whitestock."
[*] Added a new game mode: drift zones.
[*] Added a new car - FS Bandit in Sedan and Pickup versions.
[*] Added particle effects to checkpoints.
[*] Added display of the best score in the track selection menu.
[*] Added additional score information on the leaderboard.
[*] Added the ability to install a blow-off valve for the new pipe system (temporary version, requires more effort).
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the rendering system - significant performance improvement.
[*] Changes to driving physics.
[*] Changes to tire grip.
[*] Changes to suspension calculations.
[*] UI fixes and minor changes.
[*] From now on, part positioning and sheet metal straightening are separated.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.6.5
notes.content:
Hello fellow Tuners! With Christmas just around the corner, we'd like to give you a Christmas gift from ourselves too! A new update, and with it a ton of new content!
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with the ESC button not working reliably
[*] Fixed loading parts in part catalogue
[*] Fixed issues with saves corrupting
[*] Fixed issues with stickers on Blitz Gamma
[*] Increased UI performance
[*] Fixed issues with the handbrake with ABS enabled
[*] Fixed issues with the ability to mount multiple engines into one car from engine kits
[*] Fixed issues with 100% part condition after re-mounting it onto the vehicle
[*] Fixed issues with saving part condition
[*] Fixed issues with dropping FPS after leaving painting booth
[*] Fixed issues with unwanted stickers stuck on car body after leaving the paint booth
[*] Fixed issues with vanishing skidmarks
[*] Fixed issues with no compatible parts for Hashimura Civil
[*] Fixed issues with infinite turbo sound
[/list]
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Car Tune : Project now supports Steam Trading Cards
[*] New garage that can be decorated to the users liking
[*] New car "Mitsumi Sunset" (based on the Mitsubishi Eclipse 2G)
[*] Freeroam map is growing bigger (now you're able to race on countryside roads)
[*] Freeroam map now has traffic
[*] Freeroam map now has police cars, you can pay fines and start a chase
[*] Added drag races at night on freeroam map
[*] New map "Industrial Area"
[*] New rear spoilers
[*] New mufflers
[*] New aftermarket parts for BAW X46
[*] New rims
[*] Now you can open a Fullscreen map pressing "M"
[*] New camera position from car roof
[*] Camera rotation option while reversing (can be found under Options->Gameplay)
[*] New photo mode with magazine covers (Like in NFS:Underground 2, they can be found on freeroam map)
[*] Now you can check the sound a part makes in the part calatogue (e.g. blow off valve sound)
[*] Now you can find collectibles on freeroam map
[*] Now you can tow a trailer if you have equipped tow hook (trailers are placed on freeroam map)
[*] Now you're able to filter rims and tires by it's size
[*] Now you can set up tracion control in engine control unit
[*] Now you can fill your tank on gas station or after buying gas canister in parts catalogue
[*] Now you're able to start the engine in garage
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can't drive without a battery installed in the car
[*] Now you can only save your game in the garage
[*] Improved car paint shader
[*] Improved car physics
[*] Improved collisions with ground
[*] Improved post-processing effects
[*] Slightly improved performance
[*] Improved tire smoke particles
[*] Improved exhaust sounds
[*] Improved blow-off sounds
[*] Now you can get 50k credits for free if you're below 5k credits
[*] Free camera mode was changed, you're no longer able to fly through walls and objects
[*] Loading game is much faster, because now we're saving generated parts preview images after first start of the game
[*] Now saves are placed in "Profiles" folder in game directory
[*] Faster loading stickers in painting booth
[/list]
[b]Info on further updates:[/b]
Freeroam map is still in progress, we're working hard to make it bigger and better with every update,
Sometimes the objects in your inventory can be rendered wrong
Not all the features that we worked on for this whole time are available in this update. So stay tuned.
We still want to rework whole painting booth system to make it better.
In future updates we finally want to add modding support (e.g. you will be able to place your own rims models in game)
We would also want to hear from you some feedback about the update. Did you enjoy it? Do you think our effort to make the gameplay more fun and enjoyable was worth it? If you find any issues, please contact with us (send us your CrashLog from game directory).

That's it for the moment, as always.. Happy Tuning!

[b] Siwek
Community Manager[/b]

notes.title: Game Update 0.6.3
notes.content:
Hello Tuners!
We've got another update for you today, Wichur worked very hard on that one, and we hope you will enjoy!

Fixes:
•	REAGER rear quarter panels in Wagen Corridor causing the game to freeze have been fixed
•	Problems with loading in mounted parts on the vehicle have been fixed
•	The gearbox position has been fixed
•	Clutch slip at higher power outputs has been fixed
•	All wheels turning on the dyno regardless of the cars’ drivetrain have been fixed
•	I6 pulley model has been improved
•	Fixed the ability to mount the top wishbone without the steering knuckle removed
•	Fixed the lifter position after coming back to the garage
•	Fixed adjustable parts positioning issues
•	Better optimisation on the parking lot
•	Fixed the error with parts staying in the inventory after selling them


Content:
• New bumpers for the TIFA QUINGENTI and a tailgate with a lock 
• Displaying parent parts in pull-elements mode 
• Inspection of parts: the condition and the parts that can be fitted to the component 
• The engine power chart has been totally rebuilt to reduce / eliminate possible calculation errors and gives room for major future modifications. 
• Additional clutches with different power handling abilities
• New rims and a couple of new tires 
• Steam workshop implementation, the ability to send the created car to the Steam workshop where other players can subscribe to it. These vehicles will show up at the car dealer and at drag races. 
• The history of modifications on vehicles and the number of owners is saved, you can view it by clicking on the name of the car in the garage (upper right corner) or at the car dealer (an additional button will appear) 
• Every now and then the phone rings with orders, but orders cannot be accepted, it is a prepared option for subsequent updates. 
• The possibility of installing a NOS system has been added for all cars and engines 
• The view of the clipboard with parts has been changed, located at the bottom of the screen due to the large amount of information on how to open it roughly before loading the part. Please write if this option is better for you. 
• The appearance and place of inventory have been changed
• Added a button to sell all the parts and tools from the inventory
• Tweaked used car prices in the car lot
• Added drivers to AI rival cars

Info
[b]Creating a new profile save would be recommended due to a heavy code rebuild, some of the data can create errors, although it may work. If may problems with loading, game will freeze please delete Profile.save file from game folder[/b]
The amount of money in the garage will be reduced soon due to implementing a game economy.

Happy tuning!

[b] MJay
Community Manager[/b]

As a first, I'm thanking all the people for being so patient, recently Wichur has been working on the project solo, so the progress didn't go as fast as we'd have hoped to,

notes.title: Update 01/11/2020: A ton of new things! [Version: 0.5a1]
notes.content:
Welcome back!

First off, a lot of people complained due to the fact, that we left the game without updates for such a long time; We're sorry for keeping you waiting for this long, we were trying our best to fix all the game-breakers to give you a stable version of the game, and due to most of us still being in a full-time job it wasn't possible to release the update as quickly as we wanted.
It won't happen again however, we will do our best to update the game with hotfixes more often and add things along the way ;)
Now, let's kick off with the update log!

[GRAPHICS]
- Improved graphics
- Optimization, Improved performance

[CONTENT]
- Car: BAW x36 Coupe added
- Car: BAW x46 Coupe added
- Car: FS Polsky Coupe added
- Car: Hashimura Civil added
- New wheels
- New audio parts (PS: Car audio is only cosmetic for now, due to the fact that the practical side of it caused bugs; We will fix it in the future update!)
- New stickers
- Parts colour variant support
- Car lot, multiple cars on a single profile
- Inline 6 engine in a couple of different variants
- Track selector with different game modes (WIP)

[GAMEPLAY]
- Car collisions optimised
- fully reworked vehicle physics
- Steering wheel and gamepad support
- Changed car building, save/load structure
- New part mounting system
- Bodywork repair is now functional!

[FIXES/MISC]
- Fixed v6 engine
- Fixed turbochargers
- Dyno fixes
- Fixed camera target offset

We hope you'll enjoy the update! Also, happy belated Halloween!

Also, let's talk about future update content, as in what are we planning.

[FUTURE UPDATES]
- Making the paint booth better, along with a sticker system
- Paint mixer, so you could make your own vehicle paint
- More vehicles and tracks
- A driver's license and driving school
- A rebuilt interface
- Career mode
- A possible switch to first person camera mode.

In case of problems delete gamesettings ;)
We hope that this update will be a blast for the long waiting fans; thank you for being here with us!
[b] Vertices Software [/b]

notes.title: Game Update 22/02/2020
notes.content:
Welcome back!

As some of you may know or not know, we're still fixing some bugs here and there, people report them, and we continue to fix them as soon as it is physically possible.

Wichur is working really hard, he releases 2-3 bug-fixes daily at this moment, while I (MJay) am correcting the language differences, write announcements for steam as well as I also respond to questions and queries, which pop out like mushrooms do a while after the rain.
Jerry on the other hand is working on more stuff to be added into the game :)

And now today's topic: Piracy!
Unity games tend to usually be easily pirated, so Wichur decided to implement his own anti-piracy measures, after all, we're a small studio, so pirating our game would mean that we wouldn't make any money for future development.
Remember: Want to support us? 
[b]Say "Nay" to The Pirate Bay![/b]

That's all for today!
Have fun!

[b]MJay
Community Support / Moderator
Vertices Software[/b]

notes.content:
Being only a moderator that procrastinates all day, I feel like I should probably, at the very least, give you guys some insights on how things are coming along. The two guys are too busy to do it... and calling them "busy" is a gross understatement. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/jS5Wg4Tk/unknown-2.png[/img]
[h1]MODELS AND MORE MODELS![/h1]
While Bartosz aka"Wichur" has been busy programming and dealing with his daily life. Mister Jerry was having fun making new models and revamping old ones. A little sneak peak. ;) 
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/HnLPNNkh/Radio.png[/img]
Every few days Jerry posts updates on what he's been working on. We get to see some screenshots of what is considered work in progress aka some "WIPkas". And we all get to stand in awe and wonder if we should erect a statue in his honor.  
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/8zydKC6N/Shifter.png[/img][img]https://i.postimg.cc/xdcvWSvH/steeringwheel.png[/img]
So yes! Work is being done for Car Tune Project and Wichur is doing the tedious tasks of getting rid of bugs and optimizing the code and making sure it all works well. (all of this while being extremely busy and exhausted) 

[h1]AND OH BY THE WAY [/h1]
We hired Andy Oliver from Dersin Studio for a very special task. To create an inline 6 engine for Car Tune. Saving Wichur from another tedious job, so he can concentrate elsewhere. (coding)
This is all thanks to the monetary support from our dear beloved Patrons! [i]Hurray[/i]

This is all for now...
Until next time! 

[b]Naik
Community Manager 
Vertices Software[/b]
